description: This header file defines functions and types related to hash lookups in a version control system, such as searching for object IDs and performing binary searches over hash tables.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Finds the position of a given object ID within a table of object IDs.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a hash within a sorted hash table, utilizing a fanout table for interval determination.

ctags.name: oid_access_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef const struct object_id *oid_access_fn(size_t index, const void *table);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:const struct object_id * ()(size_t index,const void * table)
